subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A city is not separate from nature.”?
options: The Warm Wall shows that even quiet people may have something helpful to say.
It is part of a larger environment, even when the wild arrives quietly under streetlights.
The free book box reminds the town that sharing can happen quietly in public places.
The rings showed that growth leaves marks, even when no one notices year by year.
